findings.title: Miasma Supply-Chain Worm Scope Expanded 4.5x — 32 @redhat-cloud-services npm Packages, 96 Malicious Versions in a 72-Second Window, ~10M Total Downloads
findings.affected_technology: npm @redhat-cloud-services namespace (Hybrid Cloud Console ecosystem) — 32 packages, 96 malicious versions, ~10 million cumulative downloads; 210 downstream repos confirmed compromised by Ox Security
findings.summary: SecurityWeek follow-on coverage expands the Miasma Red Hat npm worm scope from 7 to 32 packages with 96 malicious versions pushed in a 72-second automated burst (~10M cumulative downloads) and 210 confirmed downstream-credential-leak repos identified by Ox Security.

findings.title: Kirki WordPress Plugin CVE-2026-8206 — REST API Password-Reset Address-Substitution Yields Unauthenticated Admin Takeover, Active Exploitation Against ~500K Sites
findings.affected_technology: Kirki WordPress plugin versions 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 (≈500,000 active installs; embedded in many premium themes); patched 6.0.7
findings.summary: The Kirki plugin's REST API password-reset endpoint accepts an attacker-supplied email parameter, sending the reset link to the attacker instead of the account owner; Wordfence observed 222+ exploitation attempts within 24 hours on 2026-06-02.

findings.title: Oracle WebLogic CVE-2024-21182 Added to CISA KEV — Pre-Auth RCE Patched July 2024 Now Actively Exploited, 3-Day Federal Deadline 2026-06-04
findings.affected_technology: Oracle WebLogic Server (12c / 14c) instances missing the July 2024 Critical Patch Update; T3/HTTP-exposed deployments highest-risk
findings.summary: CISA added the pre-auth Oracle WebLogic RCE CVE-2024-21182 (originally patched July 2024) to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-06-01 with a 3-day federal remediation deadline of 2026-06-04 after detecting active in-the-wild exploitation.

findings.title: Progress Sitefinity CMS — Multi-CVE Critical Batch Including CVE-2026-7312 (CVSS 10.0)
findings.affected_technology: Progress Sitefinity CMS (widely-deployed enterprise .NET CMS, frequently internet-facing in mid-market and enterprise marketing-property deployments)
findings.summary: Positive Technologies dbugs surfaced a four-CVE Progress Sitefinity batch with CVE-2026-7312 at CVSS 10.0 (network, no auth, no UI) and three companion CVEs at 9.8 and 8.8; no PoC or in-the-wild exploitation yet but a wide-attack-surface CMS exposure.

findings.title: Dashlane Confirms Encrypted Vault Downloads for Fewer Than 20 Personal-Plan Users After Brute-Force / 2FA-Bypass Wave
findings.affected_technology: Dashlane password manager consumer/personal plan accounts — fewer than 20 users had encrypted vaults downloaded after attackers cleared 2FA and registered new devices
findings.summary: Dashlane updated its 2026-05-31 brute-force disclosure to confirm that encrypted vaults of fewer than 20 personal-plan users were actually downloaded after attackers cleared 2FA, contradicting yesterday's no-platform-compromise framing.

findings.title: Sophos Discloses AI-Built Ransomware Toolkit — Claude Opus + Multi-Agent Pipeline With ~80 Modules Tested Against 70+ EDR Evasion Techniques
findings.affected_technology: Threat-actor offensive capability (Sophos / CrowdStrike / Microsoft Defender targeted in the toolkit's iterative test loop); Cobalt Strike + Telegram-bot C2 deployed; Rust/Go payload binaries emitted
findings.summary: Sophos detailed a threat actor running an agentic AI-assisted ransomware development pipeline using Claude Opus and other frontier models to iteratively refine ~80 payload modules against ~70 EDR-evasion techniques, accelerating the research-to-deployment cycle to days.

findings.title: ChatGPT Share-Link Abuse — Google Ads -> ChatGPT-Hosted Fake-Outage Lure -> openew[.]app Cross-Platform Malware (LLMShare Class Extension)
findings.affected_technology: ChatGPT share feature (chatgpt.com) abused as legitimate-renderer trust vector; openew[.]app cloaked typosquat delivering Windows + macOS malware payloads
findings.summary: Push Security disclosed a campaign that buys Google Ads for ChatGPT search terms and redirects victims to a legitimate chatgpt.com share URL rendering an attacker-controlled fake-outage page, leading users to download cross-platform malware from openew[.]app.

noted.product: CIFSwitch — 19-year-old Linux CIFS-spnego-upcall LPE to root (CVE now assigned; was CVE-pending in Watchtower 2026-05-31)
noted.summary: CVE-2026-46243 now assigned to the CIFSwitch Linux LPE; GitHub checker script publicly available; defensive posture unchanged from prior advisory.

noted.product: Windows Netlogon — Microsoft denies Belgian CCB active-exploitation framing (Watchtower 2026-06-02 NEWS, score 9)
noted.summary: Microsoft told BleepingComputer it has no evidence supporting CCB's exploitation claim; operationally no change to patch-now stance.

noted.product: Apache Kafka — improper authorization on CONSUMER_GROUP_DESCRIBE API enables cross-group consumer-state disclosure
noted.summary: Apache Kafka CONSUMER_GROUP_DESCRIBE authorization bypass patched in 4.0.1 / 3.9.2; low-but-nonzero data-exposure risk in widely-deployed Kafka clusters.

noted.product: BIRD / BIRD2 BGP — stack-buffer overflow in AS_PATH mask matching
noted.summary: BIRD/BIRD2 BGP stack overflow disclosed on oss-security 2026-06-02; CVE pending; routing-edge DoS-class via crafted BGP UPDATE in route-filter context.

noted.product: OpenStack Swift proxy DoS + Neutron policy bypass (two-errata batch)
noted.summary: Routine OpenStack errata for Swift proxy DoS and Neutron policy bypass; patches available; affects Swift object-storage and Neutron networking deployments.

noted.product: Linux kernel TLS — use-after-free in tls_sk_proto_close()
noted.summary: UAF on socket-close path in kernel TLS disclosed by Oleg Sevostyanov; CVE pending; likely LPE-class with restricted trigger preconditions.

noted.product: X.Org X server + Xwayland — multi-CVE security advisory
noted.summary: Standard X.Org security batch covering multiple vulnerabilities in X server and Xwayland; mostly LPE/client-side; patch through distribution channels.

noted.product: Verizon VoLTE deployments — missing IPsec integrity protection for IMS SIP signaling
noted.summary: Telecom critical-infrastructure issue in IMS SIP signaling on Verizon VoLTE deployments; calibration data point for carrier-VoLTE risk surface.

noted.product: Collibra Agent — improper authentication + path traversal vulnerabilities
noted.summary: Enterprise data-governance product Collibra Agent contains improper-authentication and path-traversal flaws; patch when vendor publishes if Collibra is in scope.

noted.product: Appsmiths — SQL Query autocomplete renderer cross-site scripting vulnerability
noted.summary: Low-deployment SaaS internal-tooling builder XSS in SQL Query autocomplete renderer; included for completeness.

noted.product: Google Android June 2026 update — actively exploited zero-day plus 124 additional flaws (mobile-only)
noted.summary: Google patched 124 Android vulnerabilities including the actively-exploited CVE-2025-48595 (CVSS 8.4); mobile-only and OOS for our scope but logged as calibration.

noted.product: Gamaredon (Russia-aligned) weaponizes WinRAR CVE-2025-8088 to deliver GammaWorm + GammaSteel against Ukrainian targets
noted.summary: Older WinRAR path-traversal CVE re-monetized by Gamaredon for Ukraine-targeted malware delivery; calibration data point on regional APT operations.

noted.product: SideCopy (Pakistan-aligned) Operation XENOFISCAL — Afghanistan Finance Ministry targeted with Xeno RAT
noted.summary: SideCopy spear-phishing campaign against Afghanistan Finance Ministry deploying open-source Xeno RAT; regional APT, calibration only for our scope.

noted.product: Microsoft Android app — single-line-of-code account-token exposure (SecurityWeek exclusive)
noted.summary: Single code line in Microsoft Android apps reportedly bypasses protections for Microsoft account token access; mobile-only with limited corporate-defensive impact unless BYOD-exposed.

noted.product: Microsoft sends legal threats to security researcher publishing Windows exploits including BitLocker bypass (Schneier)
noted.summary: Vulnerability-disclosure-policy data point regarding Microsoft's legal posture toward a Windows-exploit researcher; track for chilling-effect trend.

noted.product: Trump Executive Order on AI Model Vetting for national-security risks
noted.summary: Policy/governance Executive Order on vetting top AI models for national-security risks; calibration data point for the AI-regulation track.

noted.product: Anthropic Mythos preview expanded to 150 additional organizations
noted.summary: Calibration data point on the Mythos / Project Glasswing track; expect corresponding vendor-advisory wave in next 30 days as partner research outputs hit coordinated disclosure.

noted.product: Garmin Empirbus Wireless Display Unit — WebSocket cross-site origin hijacking enabling full device control (CVSS 9.3)
noted.summary: OT/marine-IoT vulnerability in Garmin Empirbus Wireless Display Unit; OOS for corporate perimeter but logged for OT-fleet calibration.

noted.product: NVIDIA NVTabular (pip) — unsafe deserialization enabling RCE / data tampering
noted.summary: ML pipeline library unsafe-pickle deserialization; low corporate-deployment exposure unless ML teams use NVTabular notebooks on shared infrastructure.

noted.product: Red Hat 389 Directory Server — missing bound on LDAP controls enabling CPU/heap DoS
noted.summary: Enterprise LDAP DoS in 389 Directory Server; patch when Red Hat errata land; impact is DoS-only with no auth bypass.

noted.product: Anthropic Claude HUD (jarrodwatts/claude-hud) — COMSPEC env-var command injection on Windows
noted.summary: Niche desktop AI HUD utility command-injection via COMSPEC; another data point for the AI-coding-assistant local-RCE class.

noted.product: WeedHack Minecraft infostealer — 116K systems infected since January 2026
noted.summary: Gamer-targeting infostealer (Minecraft mods/cheats) with browser/cookie/wallet credential theft; OOS but logged for BYOD spillover awareness.

noted.summary: Industry consolidation in OT/IoT defense; calibration data point on the OT-security tooling ecosystem.
